channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: From Tobs glory to Wilson Prep’s walk-off kick—the unforgettable local sports moments of 2025
item.description: From Wilson Tobs’ storybook title and relocation to Wilson Prep’s last-second football crown, 2025 delivered rare championships, emotional farewells and big changes across the local sports scene.

item.title: “He knew what to do’: Teen saves older brother’s life
item.description: A Wilson County 14-year-old used CPR training he received at school to save his older brother after a seizure left him face down in a remote swamp during a duck hunt, family says.

item.title: Down to Business: New year brings business and baseball
item.description: Wilson enters 2026 with business growth, a downtown boom and the Wilson Warbirds stadium nearing opening.

item.title: Chamber annual meeting will honor 3C Store Fixtures owner
item.description: Wilson Chamber’s 102nd annual meeting will honor 3C Store Fixtures owner Carolyn B. Daniel as Distinguished Citizen of the Year and grant lifetime membership awards to Grant Goings and Jack Wiggins.

item.title: Wilson County deed transfers recorded week of Dec. 22-26
item.description: More than $6 million in Wilson County property changed hands Dec. 22-26, with major commercial deals on U.S. 301, Black Creek Road and Goldsboro Street among the latest deed transfers.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 5-6, 2026
item.description: Full slate of high school hoops tips off Jan. 5-6, with boys, girls and JV matchups featuring Wilson Prep, Fike, Hunt, Greenfield, Wilson Christian and more around the region.

item.title: Mountain Lions end BC women’s win streak at 5
item.description: Young Harris snapped Barton’s five-game win streak 59-52, with Bulldogs’ shooting and rebounding woes proving costly.

item.title: Bulldogs can’t stop Young Harris at the line in loss
item.description: Despite 25 points from Jaylen Faber and 53% team shooting, Barton fell 101-92 at Young Harris, where Carl Cleveland’s 39 points and 34 free throws decided a tight contest.

item.title: Wilson Prep shuts down Hertford girls 70-12
item.description: Wilson Prep’s girls hammered 3-A Hertford County 70-12 at their New Year’s Showcase, riding a suffocating defense and Paris “Boogie” Best’s near triple-double to a fourth straight win.

item.title: Tigers grind past Bears in showcase finale
item.description: Wilson Prep hammers Hertford County 76-56 behind suffocating defense and 57 rebounds, finishing its New Year’s Showcase 2-0 and leaning into a gritty “dogs” identity despite continued shooting and free-throw struggles.
